MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 25
   C. 31
   D. 27

4. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 2

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 26

6. Solve for x: x + 6 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 18
   C. 6
   D. 13

7. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 7

9. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 24

10. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

12. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x > 5

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 50

14. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

15. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 7

16. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

17. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

18. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

19. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

20. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 12

22. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

23. Solve for x: x + 4 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 7
   C. 4
   D. 6

24. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

25. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 40

26. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 1

27. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 73

28. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 1

29. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

30. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40.5
   C. 9
   D. 81

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
